rationale: The assistant correctly identified OF OF as demo/cooling-off mode, gave exit steps, and noted the manual confirms the exact buttons. After the customer exited, it gave sensible food-safety guidance (8C, 4-hour rule, discard chicken if unsure) and no part or engineer was recommended. Minor weaknesses: it guessed at the button pair, mentioned control board failure speculatively, and did not ask how long the food had been warm, though it advised conservatively. It also said 'Nothing was broken' with slightly more certainty than the evidence at that point allowed, though the recovery was consistent with it. The reply to the kids' button pressing was well tied to the prevention advice.
